, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Ermesinda of Bigorre’s father as “Bernard II, Count of Bigorre,” conflating him with her brother and not her father (Bernard-Roger, Count of Bigorre). This unverified assumption introduced the wrong maternal grandfather candidate before evidence was checked.
